newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico two-year Bondes rate falls at auction.
newsitem.headline: Mexico two-year Bondes rate falls at auction.

text.p: The rate on Mexican two-year government development bonds, or Bondes, fell 0.34 percentage points to 1.35 percent above the 28-day Cetes rate in Tuesday's primary auction, dealers estimated.
The 728-day Bondes were assigned at 97.86841 pesos.
Demand for the two-year bondes was 3.041 billion pesos, compared with the 500 million offered by the Banco de Mexico.
For the first time since November 21, 1995, the central bank also offered one-year Bondes.
They were assigned at a rate of 1.19 percent over 28-day Cetes and a price of 98.94408 pesos.
Demand was 3.446 billion pesos with an offer of 500 million pesos.
